description: This file is a test class for the CohortEditor component within the OpenMRS project. It uses JUnit 5 for testing and extends a base property editor test class to verify the behavior of CohortEditor, including data setup and object retrieval.

classes.name: CohortEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for the CohortEditor, extending a base test class to verify property editing capabilities for Cohort objects.

methods.name: prepareData
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test execution by loading a predefined dataset.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CohortEditor.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Cohort object from the CohortService based on a predefined ID.
